notes.title: Unlock Release: New Unlockable Maps & Cubes
notes.content:
For today's release, we have added in:

 - 4 new unlockable maps: Forest, Desert, Wizard's Tower, and Village
 - 5 new unlockable cubes: Deluge, Nova,  Corinth, Galadron, Stalactite
 - 1 new alternate soundtrack: Good Vibes with tracks by James Gargette & Pro Sensory

To unlock these new features, you simply need to hit a score milestone with each of the cube sizes from 4 to 8. Look at the achievement list in Steam to see what score you need to get the map or cube you want.

notes.title: New Update: Beachside Background, Controller Support, & UI Update!
notes.content:
Patch notes:
 - Fixed several small bugs in UI navigation with the mouse
 - Fixed a bug where the particle system, whether enabled or disabled, always showed up as disabled in the in-game menu
 - Modified the leaderboard to allow switching between leaderboards on cube size
 - Added a new cube size submenu to allow easier switching between cube sizes
 - Modified help menu to display controls for controller or keyboard, depending on what is being used
 - Fixed several bugs in the controller test build relating to switching between keyboard/controller

New features:
 - Added a new tooltip system that will display control tips and gameplay tips occasionally
 - Added a new animated background map
 - Added controller support for: xbox, playstation, steam deck, and several controller types adjacent to these three

notes.title: Bug Fix: Leaderboards & Achievement API
notes.content:
- Fixed bug where 8x8x8 cubes would update to the 7x7x7 leaderboard instead of the 8x8x8 leaderboard.
- Fixed bug where Steam achievements wouldn't update after achieving their prerequisite conditions.
